title: Card 2 "Site at a glance": layers around each Vancouver candidate lot

sources.tiles: *.json,: City of Vancouver Open Data (property parcel polygons; property tax report 2026; building footprints 2009); City of Vancouver LiDAR 2022. Open Government Licence - Vancouver.
sources.census: Statistics Canada, Census of Population 2021 (98-401-X2021006), DA boundaries (92-160-X). Statistics Canada Open Licence.
sources.osm: (the project's 13 Nov 2026 Overpass extract; the source of . © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.
sources.licences: (the source of: City of Vancouver Open Data, business licences, issued 2026. Open Government Licence - Vancouver.
sources.receivers: without licensed property list rows: City non-market housing (vanNMH), City building energy and emissions reports (vanGHGrep), StatCan ODEF / ODHF / ODSRF, BC care facilities (bcCare), BC post-secondary (bcPSI).
sources.heat: econ_heat_intensity (NRCan CEUD 2023; vanNEURates2026), econ_era_multiplier (not applied); SX.kwhm2, SX.eff, useOf.
sources.noise: register van6555zones, src_fill_van6555s21; vZone and noiseLimitAt.
sources.sitemodels: scratchpad sitemodels_van/*.json: 609 files, 597 with a site model, 12 with an error record (skipped: listed in stats.skipped).

people.source: Statistics Canada, Census of Population 2021 (98-401-X2021006) and DA boundaries (92-160-X); spread uniformly within each dissemination area; cells under 0.5 people dropped (about 0.1% of people in the Vancouver area, 1.4% in the Edmonton area, mostly rural)
people.method: 100 m cells; per lot the cells whose centre is within 250 m and their sum; per parcel the people in the cell holding its centre (people per ha). [estimate]: each dissemination area's population is spread evenly over its area.
gaps: Not per building: the census gives counts per dissemination area only; any finer split would be a new assumption.
Spread evenly over the whole DA, including parks, roads and industrial land, so industrial lots read people that live a block away.

zoningUse.source: Zoning: City of Vancouver Open Data, property parcel polygons and property tax report 2026 (as in *.json A: address, zoning, zoning class, legal type). Use: OpenStreetMap (raw Overpass extract of 2026-11-13T21:35:33Z, the one behind, same tag filter as; © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0); City of Vancouver Open Data, business licences issued 2026 (type and subtype; no names in the file); tool receivers (City non-market housing, StatCan ODEF / ODHF / ODSRF, BC care and post-secondary lists, City building-energy reports; licensed property records (local only) rows left out).
zoningUse.method: OSM points and receivers placed in the building footprint and the parcel that holds them; licences placed in the parcel that holds their point (the City geocodes to the address).
gaps: OSM is points of interest only (shops, restaurants, offices, public programs, hotels): homes and most industrial buildings have no OSM use; housing shows through zone, licences and the non-market housing list.
OSM building-level tags (building=house, apartments) are not in the extract; a fresh OSM pull would need the project's OK.
Licence names are not in the City file, so licences give a type and a count, not a name.
Assessed values and year built in the tax report are left out (they come from licensed property records (local only)).

heightHeat.source: Heights: *.json B (City of Vancouver building footprints 2009 with LiDAR 2022 measured heights where matched; flags). Heat: register econ_heat_intensity (NRCan CEUD 2023, BC, conf 80; residential: NEU reference building, RTS 18251), method of gather.
heightHeat.method: Floor area = footprint x storeys (height / 3.5 m, rounded, at least 1; one storey where no height). Heat = floor area x delivered intensity by use (residential 109, commercial all 159, industrial 150 = BC warehousing, a proxy; kWh/m2 a year) x 0.80-0.90 (the gas boiler a loop replaces). Use from the parcel zone (useOf). econ_era_multiplier not applied: it applies only to offices and schools, which zone-read use never gives, as in the tool.
gaps: CD-1 and other comprehensive or unknown zones get no estimate (no sourced intensity), shown null.
Use from zone, not from the building: a house in a C-2 zone reads commercial.
Storeys from height / 3.5 m: wrong for tall single-storey sheds and for houses with pitched roofs.
The tool's anchor override heatEcon for receivers) is not re-run here; measured City-report demand is given separately as qm where present.

noise.source: City of Vancouver Noise Control By-law 6555 (consolidated to 14 Jul 2026): ss. 2.1-2.3, Sch. A, B, B.1, G; register van6555zones and src_fill_van6555s21 (conf 90). Zone classes: VZ / VACT / VMID / vZone run as written (Sch. B.1 outline from City open data noise control areas).
noise.method: Source class = the candidate lot's zone; receiving class = each neighbouring parcel's zone (and the B.1 outline at its centre). Night / day dBA: quiet source 45 / 55 to quiet, 55 / 60 to other (s. 2.1); intermediate 50 / 60, 65 / 70 (s. 2.2); activity or event 55 / 60, 65 / 70 (s. 2.3). Night values match noiseLimitAt; day values from the register text.
gaps: Parcels with no zoning record (1 % of parcel rows) get the looser limit, flagged "u".
Limits are for continuous sound (more than 3 minutes in 15), at the point of reception; the by-law's other parts (generator testing s. 4.1(c), amplified sound) are not here.
Event-zone receivers are read as "other" (s. 2.1(a)(ii) groups them with intermediate and activity).

rules: No licensed property records (local only) data (no assessed values, no year built, no licensed property list receivers), no owner names, no Edmonton or licensed lot outlines (not published) data.
